purpose: Enumerate and quotient every reachable production graph mutation in the frozen source boundary without relying on a hand-written move-name list.

abstract_grammar.DirectMutation: MutationRoot x ReceiverDomain x ParameterAssignment x SideConditionAssignment
abstract_grammar.MatchedRewrite: MatcherRoot x MatchDomain x RewriteRoot x ParameterAssignment x SideConditionAssignment
abstract_grammar.CompositeDriverStep: DriverRoot x ReachableChildMove x DriverState x SchedulingPolicy
abstract_grammar.RegisteredMutation: RegistryConstructionPath x RegistryKey x RegisteredCallable x InvocationContext
abstract_grammar.NormalizedEffect: CanonicalBeforeGraph x CanonicalAfterGraph x CanonicalReturnValue x CanonicalRaisedException x ObservableMetadataDelta
abstract_grammar.CanonicalEffectClass: equivalence class of MoveInstance under ExtensionalEquivalence

mutation_root_discovery.graph_receiver_types: derive from the uniquely resolved source by tracing concrete graph classes and declared graph protocols reachable from production roots
mutation_sinks: method call that mutates a reachable graph receiver
attribute assignment or deletion on a reachable graph receiver or its mutable owned state
item assignment or deletion on a reachable graph-owned container
in-place operator on graph-owned mutable state
call returning a delta, replacement, phase update, edge table, vertex table, or command later applied to the graph
call into a native or optional extension that mutates the graph
context-manager exit or callback that commits a pending mutation
mutation_root_discovery.root_rule: A reachable callable is a mutation root when at least one admissible path from its entry to a mutation sink exists without passing through another already-recorded mutation root, or when callers expose it as a separately selectable production move.
mutation_root_discovery.wrapper_rule: Wrappers, aliases, partial applications, registry entries, re-exports, bound methods, and callbacks remain distinct syntactic instances until extensional equivalence is proved.
mutation_root_discovery.composite_rule: A driver that can select or schedule child mutations is recorded both as a composite driver and as edges to every reachable child; it is not silently replaced by the child list.
mutation_root_discovery.dynamic_rule: Every unresolved reflective, string-selected, plugin, monkey-patched, or native edge fails closed as `SOURCE_BOUNDARY_COUNTEREXAMPLE` unless its complete finite target set is frozen and evidenced.

move_instance_expansion.receiver_domain: all canonical receiver-state classes admitted by the frozen production entry roots
side_condition_sources: exceptional branches that prevent or roll back mutation
move_instance_expansion.finite_domain_rule: Every parameter or side-condition dimension must be reduced to a finite symbolic partition whose members have proved identical control-flow and normalized-effect semantics, or the protocol terminates `UNBOUNDED_PARAMETER_DOMAIN`.
move_instance_expansion.match_domain_rule: Matchers are expanded over canonical match classes, including empty, singleton, overlapping, conflicting, maximal, and nonmaximal matches when reachable.
move_instance_expansion.no_op_rule: A selectable production call that is admissible but leaves the canonical graph unchanged is retained as a no-op effect class when its return value, exception behavior, or metadata is observably distinct; otherwise it may quotient with the canonical no-op.

canonical_graph_encoding.vertex_order: canonical labeling independent of allocation order and incidental integer identifiers
canonical_graph_encoding.edge_order: lexicographic order over canonical endpoints and normalized edge type
canonical_graph_encoding.scalar_and_phase_encoding: exact normalized representation; no floating-point approximation
canonical_graph_encoding.metadata: include every field observable by a later production move or by the frozen ORION caller boundary
canonical_graph_encoding.inputs_and_outputs: preserve ordered boundary roles and all semantically observable labels
canonical_graph_encoding.disconnected_components: canonical multiset ordering with boundary-role ties resolved canonically
canonical_graph_encoding.invalid_graphs: record as rejected inputs or explicit exception effects; never normalize silently into valid graphs

normalized_effect.before: canonical graph encoding plus admissible non-graph state visible to the move
normalized_effect.after: canonical graph encoding plus observable non-graph state after normal return, exception, or rollback
normalized_effect.return: canonical exact encoding of the return value when observable by a production caller
normalized_effect.exception: exception class and normalized semantically relevant payload, excluding incidental stack addresses
normalized_effect.metadata_delta: all later-observable caches, phase trackers, scalar state, boundary maps, registries, and scheduling state
normalized_effect.nondeterminism_rule: Repeated execution from byte-identical canonical inputs must yield the same normalized effect under the frozen environment; otherwise terminate `NONDETERMINISTIC_EFFECT`.

distinguishing_basis.definition: A finite, prospectively generated set of canonical inputs and symbolic partitions that separates every pair of nonequivalent move instances in the frozen grammar.
construction: derive path predicates and read/write footprints for every move instance
generate a witness obligation for every pair whose symbolic normalized-effect functions are not already proved equal
solve each obligation exactly or produce a proof that the pair is equal over the complete admissible domain
minimize only after separation is established; retain proof links from every class pair to a witness or equality proof
coverage_requirements: every side-condition truth assignment that is jointly satisfiable
every boundary, scalar, phase, edge-type, and isolated-vertex case read by a move
every normal, no-op, rollback, and admissible exception effect

extensional_equivalence.definition: m1 ~ext m2 iff, for every admissible canonical input in the complete separating basis and every admissible parameter/side-condition partition, their normalized effects are identical.
required_properties: congruent_for_every_frozen_production_driver_that selects the move by registry class
extensional_equivalence.canonical_class_id: sha256 of the schema-tagged, length-delimited sorted normalized-effect function representation
extensional_equivalence.representative_rule: lexicographically least stable syntactic origin tuple; representative choice does not alter class identity
